seq_vertices.note: seq_vertices s is the set of the vertices occurring in the raw sequence s (MathComp [set:: s]), with no walk, uniqueness or nonemptiness premise: [::] gives set0, [:: v] gives [set v], repeated vertices count once and order is irrelevant, so #|seq_vertices s| = size (undup s); the head-plus-tail sequence x :: s of GraphTheory.digraph.nodes is never empty.
